concept_prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: concept preview for a native macOS app icon, Power View, a power consumption, battery, temperature and fan monitor. The user rejected a plain lightning bolt as generic and bland. Create an original, memorable custom symbol, not a stock SF Symbol. Light palette and simple silhouette, premium macOS app-icon craft, finely controlled soft depth and translucent/satin material, beautifully balanced optical spacing, readable at small sizes. One icon per image, a straight-on orthographic rounded-square macOS tile, centered and large with a little margin, on a clean very pale gray studio background. Subtle natural soft shadow, upper-left diffuse light. No text, no caption, no watermark, no desktop, no collage, no tiny dashboard markings, no dark or neon cyberpunk styling, no on/off power-button symbol, no generic lightning bolt pasted on a gradient. Make the design feel authored, not decorated.
Direction B — Energy prism: A bold sculptural vertical energy-cell emblem formed from TWO simple interlocking rounded translucent glass prisms. The two pieces form one almost-square upright battery-like block with a small integrated terminal at its top; a broad and very intentional diagonal negative-space channel slices between them, suggesting energy flowing through the cell without drawing a lightning symbol. Top glass piece is luminous pale mint, lower piece frosted glacial blue. The transparent edges have subtle depth, internal shading and soft caustic light, but the faces are calm and clean, no iridescent rainbow. Use a fresh architectural proportion, not a horizontal battery capsule or switch. Slightly offset layers feel tactile yet front-facing. Bone-white macOS tile. A memorable object-like app icon with real dimensionality and a distinctive diagonal cut.
production_prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Production preparation of an approved macOS app icon. Edit this exact image, keeping the green-and-blue GLASS BATTERY design unchanged. Preserve the entire mint upper battery half with top terminal, blue lower half, diagonal gap, highlights, shadows WITHIN the rounded ivory square tile, and the ivory tile itself. Do NOT replace it with a loop, letters, or lightning bolt. Keep colors, geometry, placement and material identical. Remove ONLY the pale studio backdrop OUTSIDE the tile. The OUTSIDE must be truly transparent PNG alpha with a perfectly clean smooth antialiased tile contour. No gray floor shadow, no leftover white halo, no jagged white noise, no speckles, no checkerboard rendered into pixels. A tiny natural edge shadow is okay but remove all broad shadows. Keep the tile large and centered, occupying about 82–84% of square canvas. This is a clean cutout of the selected battery icon, not a redesign.
packaging: The checked-in master is exported at macOS icon sizes with a consistent rounded tile silhouette and transparent padding. No AI or network access is needed at build time.
